svg.title: Design work, time, and billing
svg.desc: Design work, time, and billing. How are dated time entries matched to a billing-period rollup? Primary tables: ServiceEngagement, ServiceEngagementAssignment, ServiceTimeEntry, ServiceBillingLine. The time-to-billing match is an engagement/date-interval analysis, not a stored billing-line ID on each time entry. Non-billable time retains cost support without customer billing.
